_comment: Voice-over for scenes 1-4 (0:00-0:46). start = seconds from the start of the video (global). until = latest second the line may end (the next visual beat). 'on screen' is what the picture does at that moment. Edit text freely; only changed lines are regenerated.

lines.text: A homeowner wants solar.
lines.on screen: 4,500 types in, 'kWh a year' rises (1.7)

lines.text: All they know is one number from their bill.
lines.on screen: caption 'A homeowner wants solar. This is all they know.' (2.3-4.7); quote card rises (5.0)

lines.text: They fill in a form,
lines.on screen: number flies into the field (5.1-5.8); cursor moves (6.8) and clicks Get quote (7.8)

lines.text: and then they wait.
lines.on screen: 'Thanks! We'll call you back.' (8.2) then the clock (9.7)

lines.text: On the other side, an installer gets another lead that starts from zero.
lines.on screen: split: homeowner left, installer right (12.0); lead list (13.4); profile with ? marks (15.0)

lines.text: A planner will spend hours turning it into a design and a price.
lines.on screen: checklist types (18.0-20.7), hours bar fills

lines.text: Reonic already connects installers and their customers.
lines.on screen: after the bubble dies in the gap (21-23): 'Reonic already connects the two.' (24.5)

lines.text: We wanted to go... further.
lines.on screen: 'We wanted to go further' (28.2), 'further' wipes to gradient (28.7)

lines.text: Meet reo.
lines.on screen: Reonic becomes reo: slide (32.25), turn (33.5), arms (34.55), wave (34.9), lockup (35.9)

lines.text: An agentic companion, dropped onto the installer's website, doing the work in between.
lines.on screen: site rises (38.2), reo drops in (39.5-40.1), sites slide through (40.5-43.6), gap returns (43.6)

lines.text: On Sonnfeld's website, an advisor talks to the homeowner.
lines.on screen: bubble grows into the window (46.0); pointer clicks Plan my home (47.4); advisor sheet opens

lines.text: A few taps: their usage,
lines.on screen: 4500 typed (49.0), Next (50.3); ticker: Usage

lines.text: an address,
lines.on screen: address typed (51.9), Find roof (53.2); the roof glows (53.7)

lines.text: a car,
lines.on screen: Planned clicked (55.7); car and wallbox appear

lines.text: and a heating system.
lines.on screen: Gas clicked (57.8); results begin (57.8)

lines.text: And they get a design, a price range,
lines.on screen: results wide view (58-61), push to the price range marked estimate (62.6)

lines.text: and a reason for every number.
lines.on screen: pointer taps Savings (64.8); the advisor explains on the house

lines.text: Tap any number, and the advisor explains it.
lines.on screen: Send plan (66.8-68.7): name typed, Send plan clicked; sent banner (70.3)

lines.text: The planner opens the plan, and reo has already written the summary.
lines.on screen: summary and table (74-76)

lines.text: Panels are placed on the satellite image, around the skylight and the rooftop units.
lines.on screen: roof zoom (76-79), automatic layout

lines.text: The planner moves, adds or removes modules, and the price re-derives instantly.
lines.on screen: drag, three adds, remove (78.7-86.8)

lines.text: Every line of the breakdown follows the design.
lines.on screen: the price table and the re-derive banner (86.8-89.4)

lines.text: Then reo suggests the next steps: a calendar event for the site visit, a CRM task.
lines.on screen: next steps, both approved (89.4-93.1)

lines.text: A note, one click, and the quote is sent.
lines.on screen: the note typed, Send (93.1-97)

lines.text: The customer sees their confirmed quote the same moment.
lines.on screen: Quote sent hold, the cut into scene 7

lines.text: reo is an agent, not a chatbot: an engine for the numbers, the calendar, the CRM, WhatsApp.
lines.on screen: reo floats, tool tiles land one by one

lines.text: Our vision: one companion for every installer.
lines.on screen: all lines pulse, the word Vision

lines.text: Ten percent of Reonic's installers adopting reo: about seven hundred thousand dollars in new ARR.
lines.on screen: the figure, the method line, the source line

lines.text: Thank you.
lines.on screen: reo waves, then winks
